1933, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. S.
Page 131 Cont.
Aug. 9 Montgomery - McGrath Bakery Co. Mrs. Anna Spooner - 50 - throat & side .... Thomas Hobbs - 45 - cancer swolen - at Dickerson Hosp. E. Hyland. ...
Mrs. A. Hall - 65 - convert but fallen away, turned to "Scientists" and become as possessed - bitter that daughter is practical C. - Husband died Cath. 9 yrs. ago.
Marg. Holefka - 34 - over work suporting 2 sons.
August 13 Anthony Beste - 86 - grace of happy death. Russell - 33 - wants to get back on force
13 John Francis - 13 - had diptheria just before 10, lost speech and power to walk or eat - could not even drink milk. Came - carried to Monastery and enrolled in S. Mass A. and recovered - Talents still very slow - coming back - pray.
Eliz. Kopp - 30 - fell and is in critical
W.McBr ... 50 ... in local Hosptial ... cancer of stomach ... very low ... long time away from Ch'h.
Page 132 Blank Page
Page 133 Aug. 16 Sister M. Catherine Felician - deaf - very active in community - hopes to be cured - op. S.S. Cord.
Mrs. Rasico - 67 - very badly bleeding breast - seeming to be cancer.
Wend Ruttenberg - 4 - T.B. - Grandmother laments that mother has dropt practice of faith.
Mrs. B. McGuire - 74 - bumped leg on car - now like running sore. Hopkins - 55 - Pittsburgh - phoned ... O.K. Eliz. Doody - 2'2 - deaf-dumb.
